privacy.intro: Rehabbit stores your modes, onboarding answers, and Rehabbit usage events to sync them and measure whether the product helps you. We don't send your complete phone usage history.
privacy.storedBody: Mode settings, apps you choose to block, onboarding answers, and interaction events with Rehabbit.
privacy.deleteBody: Deletes data from your device and Rehabbit.

terms.title: Using Rehabbit
terms.body1: Rehabbit lets you create modes to temporarily block apps you choose. Android permissions are required for blocking to work.
terms.body2: You can edit or delete your modes and data at any time from Settings.

onboarding.androidOnly: This experience is available on Android.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Create a mode to block distractions and spend time on what matters.
onboarding.phoneUseTitle: How much time do you spend on your phone?
onboarding.phoneUseBody: We'll use this to suggest an initial plan. You can change it later.
onboarding.recoverTimeTitle: How long do you want to stop using your phone?
onboarding.recoverTimeBody: Choose the first period you want to recover.
onboarding.goalTitle: What do you want to achieve?
onboarding.goalBody: Your plan adapts to the intention you choose.
onboarding.objectivesBody: Choose one or more goals for your plan.
onboarding.blockedTitle: Which apps would you like to use less?
onboarding.blockedBody: You can adjust them whenever you want.
onboarding.modeTimeTitle: How long do you want to stop using those apps?
onboarding.modeTimeBody: This is how long you'll stay in your mode before social apps unlock.
onboarding.replacementTitle: Which app would you like to use instead?
onboarding.replacementBody: These apps become available while you stay in your mode.
onboarding.permissionsTitle: One last step to activate Rehabbit
onboarding.permissionsBody: We need these permissions for blocking to work correctly.

permissions.usageDescription: Detects when you open a blocked app.
permissions.notificationsDescription: Status and updates for your active mode.

onboarding.creatingBody: We're preparing your limits and alternatives.
onboarding.previewBody: Review it before saving. It will remain inactive until you choose to activate it.
